title: The Free Lunch Theorem of Homogenisation
summary: We show that H-convergence for multiplication type operators as envisioned by Murat and Tartar in the 1970's always implies nonlocal H-convergence as introduced in 2018 in Calc.~Var.~PDE 57(6):159. In contrast to earlier findings, the results presented here work for arbitrary space dimensions, are not bound to a certain geometry of the underlying domain, and do not explicitly require an underlying Hilbert complex for the application of any particular version of the div-curl lemma.
